/-!
# Exact prime, semiprime and unit branches of the current seventh source

The literal seventh quotient is rough at the second selected prime. Its
cofactor need not be prime: the current lower exponent is below one fourth.
The actual exponent nevertheless gives `5 * (59 / 250) > 1`, so every
cofactor is strictly below the cube of the second prime. This leaves one,
a prime, or an ordered product of two primes, including prime squares.

All branches retain the original outer pair, its strict square-root cap
with centre `N`, and the original primitive additive prime. No squarefree
receiver assumption, mean estimate, numerical sieve constant or analytic

private theorem currentChenSeventh_rough_lt_cube_classification
    {q y : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hrough : ChenPrimeRough (y : ℝ) q)
    (hsmall : q < y ^ 3) :
    q = 1 ∨ Nat.Prime q ∨ ∃ r s : ℕ,
      Nat.Prime r ∧ Nat.Prime s ∧ y ≤ r ∧ r ≤ s ∧ q = r * s := by
  by_cases hone : q = 1
  · exact Or.inl hone
  by_cases hprime : Nat.Prime q
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hprime)
  let r := Nat.minFac q
  let s := q / r
  have hr : Nat.Prime r := Nat.minFac_prime hone
  have hmul : r * s = q := Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.minFac_dvd q)
  have hrs : r ≤ s := Nat.minFac_le_div hq hprime
  have hyr : y ≤ r := by
    exact_mod_cast hrough r hr (Nat.minFac_dvd q)
  have hspos : 0 < s := hr.pos.trans_le hrs
  have hsone : s ≠ 1 := by
    have hr2 := hr.two_le
    omega
  have hs : Nat.Prime s := by
    by_contra hsnot
    have ht : Nat.Prime (Nat.minFac s) := Nat.minFac_prime hsone
    have hsq : s ∣ q := by
      rw [← hmul]
      exact dvd_mul_left s r
    have hyt : y ≤ Nat.minFac s := by
      exact_mod_cast hrough (Nat.minFac s) ht ((Nat.minFac_dvd s).trans hsq)
    have hysq : y ^ 2 ≤ s :=
      (pow_le_pow_left' hyt 2).trans (Nat.minFac_sq_le_self hspos hsnot)
    have hcube : y ^ 3 ≤ q := by
      calc
        y ^ 3 = y * y ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ r * s := Nat.mul_le_mul hyr hysq
        _ = q := hmul
    exact (not_le_of_gt hsmall) hcube
  exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨r, s, hr, hs, hyr, hrs, hmul.symm⟩)

/-- The current seventh rough cofactor has at most two prime factors with
multiplicity. The inclusive lower wall allows both `r = p₂` and `r = s`. -/
theorem currentChenUpsilon7_quotient_classification {N : ℕ} {t : ℕ × ℕ}
    (ht : t ∈ chenY7PrimeSelector N ((N : ℝ) ^ (59 / 250 : ℝ))) {q : ℕ}
    (hq : q ∈ chenSiftedQuotientPrimeSource N (t.1 * t.2) (t.2 : ℝ)) :
    q < t.2 ^ 3 ∧
      (q = 1 ∨ Nat.Prime q ∨ ∃ r s : ℕ,
        Nat.Prime r ∧ Nat.Prime s ∧ t.2 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ s ∧ q = r * s) := by
  obtain ⟨hc, hD, h₁₂, _hcap⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ht
  obtain ⟨hc₁, hc₂⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hc
  have hp₁ := (mem_chenAdditivePrimeCarrier.mp hc₁).2.1
  have hp₂ := (mem_chenAdditivePrimeCarrier.mp hc₂).2.1
  have hb : 0 < t.1 * t.2 := mul_pos hp₁.pos hp₂.pos
  obtain ⟨hqsource, hrough⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hq
  obtain ⟨_P, _hP, _hmul, hlt, hqpos, _hquot⟩ :=
    currentChenUpsilon9_quotient_witness hb hqsource
  have hN : (1 : ℝ) < N := by
    exact_mod_cast lt_trans hp₁.one_lt (mem_chenAdditivePrimeCarrier.mp hc₁).1
  have hDpow : ((N : ℝ) ^ (59 / 250 : ℝ)) ^ 5 =
      (N : ℝ) ^ (59 / 50 : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul_natCast (Nat.cast_nonneg N) (59 / 250 : ℝ) 5]
    congr 1
    norm_num
  have hNpow : (N : ℝ) < ((N : ℝ) ^ (59 / 250 : ℝ)) ^ 5 := by
    rw [hDpow]
    calc
      (N : ℝ) = (N : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_one _).symm
      _ < (N : ℝ) ^ (59 / 50 : ℝ) :=
        Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hN (by norm_num)
  have hDfive : ((N : ℝ) ^ (59 / 250 : ℝ)) ^ 5 ≤ (t.1 : ℝ) ^ 5 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N) _) hD 5
  have h₁₂R : (t.1 : ℝ) ≤ (t.2 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h₁₂.le
  have hfirst : (t.1 : ℝ) ^ 5 ≤ (t.1 : ℝ) * (t.2 : ℝ) ^ 4 := by
    calc
      (t.1 : ℝ) ^ 5 = (t.1 : ℝ) * (t.1 : ℝ) ^ 4 := by ring
      _ ≤ (t.1 : ℝ) * (t.2 : ℝ) ^ 4 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) h₁₂R 4) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hNprod : (N : ℝ) < (t.1 : ℝ) * (t.2 : ℝ) ^ 4 :=
    hNpow.trans_le (hDfive.trans hfirst)
  have hqsmall : q < t.2 ^ 3 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hlower : t.2 ^ 3 ≤ q := Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot
    have hlowerR : (t.2 : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hlower
    have hltR : (t.1 : ℝ) * (t.2 : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hlt
    have hprod : (t.1 : ℝ) * (t.2 : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤
        (t.1 : ℝ) * (t.2 : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) := by
      calc
        (t.1 : ℝ) * (t.2 : ℝ) ^ 4 =
            ((t.1 : ℝ) * (t.2 : ℝ)) * (t.2 : ℝ) ^ 3 := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlowerR
          (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hprod) (hltR.trans hNprod)
  exact ⟨hqsmall, currentChenSeventh_rough_lt_cube_classification hqpos hrough hqsmall⟩

private theorem currentChenSeventh_sifted_mem_iff {N b q : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (z : ℝ) :
    q ∈ chenSiftedQuotientPrimeSource N b z ↔
      b * q < N ∧ N - b * q ∈ chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N ∧ ChenPrimeRough z q := by
  constructor
  · intro hq
    obtain ⟨hqsource, hrough⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hq
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hmul, hlt, _hqpos, _hquot⟩ :=
      currentChenUpsilon9_quotient_witness hb hqsource
    have hPN := (mem_chenAdditivePrimeCarrier.mp hP).1
    have hrecover : N - b * q = P := by omega
    exact ⟨hlt, by simpa only [hrecover] using hP, hrough⟩
  · rintro ⟨hlt, hP, hrough⟩
    have hreceiver : N - (N - b * q) = b * q := Nat.sub_sub_self hlt.le
    have hdiv : b ∣ N - (N - b * q) := by
      rw [hreceiver]
      exact dvd_mul_right b q
    have hquot : (N - (N - b * q)) / b = q := by
      rw [hreceiver]
      exact Nat.mul_div_cancel_left q hb
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨N - b * q,
        mem_chenQuotientPrimeCarrier.mpr ⟨hP, hdiv⟩, hquot⟩, hrough⟩

private theorem currentChenSeventh_rough_prime_mul_iff {r s : ℕ} {z : ℝ}
    (hr : Nat.Prime r) (hs : Nat.Prime s) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    ChenPrimeRough z (r * s) ↔ z ≤ (r : ℝ) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h r hr (dvd_mul_right r s)
  · intro h q hq hdiv
    rcases hq.dvd_mul.mp hdiv with hdr | hds
    · have heq : q = r := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq hr).mp hdr
      simpa only [heq] using h
    · have heq : q = s := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq hs).mp hds
      subst q
      exact h.trans (by exact_mod_cast hrs)

private theorem currentChenSeventh_prime_factor_mem_carrier {N b q r : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hq : q ∈ chenQuotientPrimeSource N b)
    (hr : Nat.Prime r) (hrq : r ∣ q) : r ∈ chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N := by
  obtain ⟨_P, _hP, _hmul, hlt, hqpos, _hquot⟩ :=
    currentChenUpsilon9_quotient_witness hb hq
  have hqle : q ≤ b * q := by
    calc
      q = 1 * q := (one_mul q).symm
      _ ≤ b * q := Nat.mul_le_mul_right q (by omega)
  have hrle : r ≤ q := Nat.le_of_dvd hqpos hrq
  exact mem_chenAdditivePrimeCarrier.mpr
    ⟨hrle.trans_lt (hqle.trans_lt hlt), hr,
      (chenQuotientPrimeSource_data hq).2.2.of_dvd_left hrq⟩

/-!
# Fixed sublinear power errors are negligible in the actual normalization

For every fixed real `theta < 1`, fixed real coefficient `c`, and natural
logarithm exponent `k`, the error `c * N^theta * (log N)^k + 1` is eventually
at most any prescribed positive multiple of `singularNormalization N`.
In particular, this applies to every nonnegative finite real coefficient.

The proof derives the needed decay from mathlib's proved log-power versus
positive-real-power asymptotic. It then uses the genuine, uniformly positive
singular-series lower constant and the already proved divergence of the
normalization. No asymptotic estimate or count bound is assumed.

Ceiling and floor corollaries require `c ≥ 0` and prove the needed sign on
large natural arguments. The final specializations cover the literal cap
`N^(1/5)` and its precise natural ceiling.

The log-power asymptotic and real-power algebra APIs were checked against
mathlib revision `e4c91783ca8e6a7c693ae624ade32fd22d4e43c1`, in
`Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Pow/Asymptotics.lean` and `Pow/Real.lean`.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

open Filter Topology

/-- Any fixed natural power of the logarithm is negligible relative to a
positive real power of the natural argument. This is a proved limit. -/
theorem tendsto_nat_log_pow_div_rpow (k : ℕ) {delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 < delta) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ k / (N : ℝ) ^ delta)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hreal : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Real.log x) ^ k / x ^ delta)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_natCast] using
      (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop (k : ℝ) hdelta).tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  exact hreal.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop

/-- A fixed sublinear real power times a fixed logarithm power has
arbitrarily small normalized upper cost. No sign hypothesis on `c` or
lower bound on `theta` is needed for this upper estimate. -/
theorem eventually_powerLog_le_singularNormalization
    (c theta : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (htheta : theta < 1) :
    ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon →
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
        c * (N : ℝ) ^ theta * (Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ k ≤
          epsilon * singularNormalization N := by
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  have hdecay : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
      c * ((Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ (k + 2) / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - theta)))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using
      (tendsto_nat_log_pow_div_rpow (k + 2) (sub_pos.mpr htheta)).const_mul c
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      c * ((Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ (k + 2) / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - theta)) <
        epsilon * twinPrimeConstant :=
    hdecay.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (mul_pos hepsilon twinPrimeConstant_pos))
  filter_upwards [hsmall, eventually_ge_atTop (2 : ℕ)] with N hsmallN hN
  have hNreal : (1 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 < N by omega)
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := lt_trans zero_lt_one hNreal
  have hlog : Real.log (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.log_pos hNreal)
  have hpow : (N : ℝ) ^ theta ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hNpos theta)
  have hbase : 0 ≤ (N : ℝ) / (Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ 2 :=
    div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N) (sq_nonneg _)
  calc
    c * (N : ℝ) ^ theta * (Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ k =
        (c * ((Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ (k + 2) / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - theta))) *
          ((N : ℝ) / (Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ 2) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_sub hNpos, Real.rpow_one, pow_add]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hNpos, hlog, hpow] <;> ring
    _ ≤ (epsilon * twinPrimeConstant) *
        ((N : ℝ) / (Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmallN.le hbase
    _ = epsilon *
        (twinPrimeConstant * (N : ℝ) / (Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ 2) := by ring
    _ ≤ epsilon * singularNormalization N :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (singularNormalization_lower N) hepsilon.le

/-- The same power-logarithm error with its additive unit. The unit is
absorbed using the proved divergence of the actual normalization. -/
theorem eventually_powerLog_add_one_le_singularNormalization
    (c theta : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (htheta : theta < 1) :
    ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon →
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
        c * (N : ℝ) ^ theta * (Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ k + 1 ≤
          epsilon * singularNormalization N := by
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  filter_upwards
    [eventually_powerLog_le_singularNormalization c theta k htheta
      (epsilon / 2) (half_pos hepsilon),
      eventually_singularNormalization_unit_absorption (epsilon / 2) (half_pos hepsilon)]
    with N hpower hunit
  linarith

/-- The sign needed for natural floor and ceiling estimates is proved
explicitly once the natural argument is at least one. -/
theorem powerLog_nonneg {c theta : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    0 ≤ c * (N : ℝ) ^ theta * (Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ k := by
  have hNreal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN
  exact mul_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg hc (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N) theta))
    (pow_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hNreal) k)

/-- Exact natural ceilings of nonnegative power-logarithm errors have
arbitrarily small normalized cost. The ceiling loss is at most one. -/
theorem eventually_ceil_powerLog_le_singularNormalization
    (c theta : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (htheta : theta < 1) :
    ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon →
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
        (Nat.ceil (c * (N : ℝ) ^ theta * (Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ k) : ℝ) ≤
          epsilon * singularNormalization N := by
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  filter_upwards
    [eventually_powerLog_add_one_le_singularNormalization c theta k htheta
      epsilon hepsilon, eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with N herror hN
  exact (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (powerLog_nonneg hc k N hN)).le.trans herror

/-- Natural floors plus one satisfy the same proved error budget. -/
theorem eventually_floor_powerLog_add_one_le_singularNormalization
    (c theta : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (htheta : theta < 1) :
    ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon →
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
        (Nat.floor (c * (N : ℝ) ^ theta * (Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ k) : ℝ) + 1 ≤
          epsilon * singularNormalization N := by
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  filter_upwards
    [eventually_powerLog_add_one_le_singularNormalization c theta k htheta
      epsilon hepsilon, eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with N herror hN
  exact (add_le_add (Nat.floor_le (powerLog_nonneg hc k N hN)) le_rfl).trans herror

/-- The literal fifth-root small-prime cap, with an additive unit, is
negligible relative to the actual manuscript normalization. -/
theorem eventually_fifthRoot_add_one_le_singularNormalization :
    ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon →
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
        (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) + 1 ≤ epsilon * singularNormalization N := by
  simpa only [one_mul, pow_zero, mul_one] using
    eventually_powerLog_add_one_le_singularNormalization 1 (1 / 5) 0 (by norm_num)

/-- The same literal fifth-root cap rounded up to a natural number. -/
theorem eventually_ceil_fifthRoot_le_singularNormalization :
    ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon →
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
        (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ)) : ℝ) ≤
          epsilon * singularNormalization N := by
  simpa only [one_mul, pow_zero, mul_one] using
    eventually_ceil_powerLog_le_singularNormalization 1 (1 / 5) 0
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

Every unit fibre retains its original pair label.  The literal selector

and `ceil (N^(1/2))`.  Counting this rectangle gives the actual finite

at least one, without simplifying the original selector by assumption. -/

      Finset.range (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ (59 / 250 : ℝ))) ×ˢ
        Finset.range (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))) := by
  intro t ht

  obtain ⟨hcarrier, _, h₁D, _, hcap⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp htselector

  have hsecond : 1 ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=

    have hceil := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one

/-- Two factorizations into two primes agree up to swapping their factors.
Repeated factors are allowed. -/
theorem prime_mul_eq_prime_mul_iff {r q s t : ℕ}
    (hr : Nat.Prime r) (hq : Nat.Prime q)
    (hs : Nat.Prime s) (ht : Nat.Prime t) :
    r * q = s * t ↔ (r = s ∧ q = t) ∨ (r = t ∧ q = s) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hdiv : r ∣ s * t := by
      rw [← h]
      exact dvd_mul_right r q
    rcases hr.dvd_mul.mp hdiv with hrs | hrt
    · have heq : r = s := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hr hs).mp hrs
      subst s
      exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, (mul_right_inj' hr.ne_zero).mp h⟩
    · have heq : r = t := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hr ht).mp hrt
      subst t
      have h' : r * q = r * s := h.trans (Nat.mul_comm s r)
      exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, (mul_right_inj' hr.ne_zero).mp h'⟩
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · rfl
    · exact Nat.mul_comm _ _

    (hs : Nat.Prime s) (ht : Nat.Prime t)
    (hrq : r ≤ q) (hst : s ≤ t) (hprod : r * q = s * t) :
    r = s ∧ q = t := by
  rcases (prime_mul_eq_prime_mul_iff hr hq hs ht).mp hprod with
    hsame | ⟨hrt, hqs⟩
  · exact hsame
  · omega
